summary: Frontend-only round-3 verification on Hi Tours Egypt package detail page (/afrika/aegypten/luxor-strand-urlaub) at desktop 1440 and mobile 390. All 9 grouped requirements from the request passed. No console errors on detail or listing page; no horizontal overflow at 390.

Header @390: eg-detail-title font-size=22px; eg-detail-stats has exactly 4 tiles (days, hotels, activities, transfers all present)
eg-detail-tags: eg-detail-cities='5 cities' + 3 eg-detail-tag chips (Culture, Honeymoon, Luxury) each with exactly 1 svg

eg-price-services has 6 li with bg rgb(251,234,219) in 2-col grid (li[0] & li[1] share top); no stars/bubbles inside eg-ratings-row (brand-stars elements exist elsewhere on page but NOT inside ratings row; tripadvisor-bubbles absent). Ratings text: 'Rated 4.7 on Google' + 'Rated 4.9 on TripAdvisor'

Expert: title 'Trip created by Ria Banerjee, product & destination expert for Egypt'; quote 'Pyramids, a relaxed Nile cruise and a Red Sea beach finale, all in one journey.' with height 52px @ line-height 26px (<=2 lines). Read more toggle appends 'Valley of the Kings' text and label becomes 'Read less'

Itinerary eg-route-section-1: 'Day 4-7' and eg-route-subtitle 'Aswan -> Edfu -> Luxor' on separate y positions (delta 52px); eg-accommodation-cta 'Customise this' and eg-activities-cta 'Customise activities' both rgb(250,221,209)
Lightbox: 'View photos (3)' opens eg-lightbox with naturalWidth=640; next changes src; counter shows '2/3'; close and Escape both close it; body overflow restored to visible

Route-at-a-glance: @1440 eg-glance-table visible with headers Day/Route/Your accommodation/Key highlights & activities + 5 body rows each with an eg-glance-photo; eg-glance-hide collapses it. @390 table hidden and 5 eg-glance-day stacked cards visible with 'Key highlights & activities' label
Sticky bar (post-scroll): contains 'From ₹1,44,000' and 'per person', does NOT contain 'Ria Banerjee' or 'our team'; exactly 1 eg-sticky-cta
Regression: scroll-spy selects eg-route-tab-2 (aria-selected=true) when section-2 near top; listing /afrika/aegypten loads with 0 console errors
critical_code_review_comments: brand-stars data-testid elements are rendered elsewhere on the page (e.g., in reviews/rating widgets) but not inside eg-ratings-row, which matches the spec. If the intent is that this testid should be globally absent from the detail page, revisit the Rating component usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All round-3 refinements verified. Note that brand-stars testid appears in other rating widgets on the page (not inside eg-ratings-row) - spec only forbids it inside eg-ratings-row and that holds.
